cmtab_entries.description: List of encrypted filesystem entries to manage via cryptmount. Each entry maps a device to a decrypted mount point using specified encryption parameters. See `man cmtab` for available keys and defaults. Note that `dev`, `dir`, `fstype`, `keyfile`, and `cipher` are effectively required for most setups, and `keyformat` is highly recommended to default to `builtin` for security unless using LUKS/raw keys.
